Done — passed on the first execution.

**`out/T4/solution.py`** streams tensors per name via `safe_open` (base is sharded, resolved through `model.safetensors.index.json`; ft1/ft2 are single files), so it never holds three 5 GB checkpoints in memory. It:

1. Checks all three checkpoints have the same 114 names, matches the 48 MLP tensors by an anchored regex on `model.layers.<i>.mlp.(gate|up|down)_proj.weight`, and asserts bit-exact equality (`torch.equal`) plus shape/dtype agreement for each of the 66 non-MLP tensors across base/ft1/ft2 — aborting with a specific message otherwise.
2. Computes `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32, reading `base` fresh per tensor so both task vectors are taken against the unmodified base.
3. Asserts 48 merged and 114 total, saves, then re-opens the written file and re-checks its key set.

Output: `out/T4/model.safetensors`, 114 tensors, 5,119,161,080 bytes. Self-report in `out/T4/REPORT.md`.
